mentions.name: Stagehand
mentions.description: Open-source browser automation framework rebuilt from the ground up as a Playwright alternative, focused on automation and self-healing using LLMs; version 3 is a total rewrite.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on rebuilding Playwright from the ground up, but focused on automation and self healing using LLMs.

It's called Stagehand (https://github.com/browserbase/stagehand) and we just released v3, which is a total rewrite.
